```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 700


library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate matching x- and y-axis spans based on the data
get_square_limits <- function(df, include_rectangles = FALSE) {
  x_values <- df$x
  y_values <- c(df$y, df$estimated)

  if (include_rectangles) {
    x_values <- c(x_values, df$x - df$error)
  }

  x_range <- range(x_values)
  y_range <- range(y_values)

  x_mid <- mean(x_range)
  y_mid <- mean(y_range)

  plot_range <- max(diff(x_range), diff(y_range), 1) * 1.1

  list(
    xlim = c(x_mid - plot_range / 2, x_mid + plot_range / 2),
    ylim = c(y_mid - plot_range / 2, y_mid + plot_range / 2)
  )
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Least Squares Regression"),

  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel(
      "Slope and Intercept",
      fluid = TRUE,
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          sliderInput("realslope", "True Slope",
                      min = -2, max = 2, value = 0, step = 0.01),
          sliderInput("realintercept", "True Intercept",
                      min = -10, max = 10, value = 0, step = 0.01),
          sliderInput("slope", "Slope",
                      min = -2, max = 2, value = 0, step = 0.01),
          sliderInput("intercept", "Intercept",
                      min = -10, max = 10, value = 0, step = 0.01)
        ),
        mainPanel(
           fluidRow(
    column(6, plotOutput("regplot", height = "500px", width = "500px")),
    column(6, plotOutput("seplot", height = "500px", width = "500px"))
  )
        )
      )
    ),

    tabPanel(
      "Slope through means",
      fluid = TRUE,
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          sliderInput("realslope2", "True Slope",
                      min = -2, max = 2, value = 0, step = 0.01),
          sliderInput("realintercept2", "True Intercept",
                      min = -10, max = 10, value = 0, step = 0.01),
          sliderInput("slope2", "Slope",
                      min = -2, max = 2, value = 0, step = 0.01)
        ),
       mainPanel(
  fluidRow(
    column(6, plotOutput("regplot2", height = "500px", width = "500px")),
    column(6, plotOutput("seplot2", height = "500px", width = "500px"))
  )
)
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {

  vals <- reactiveValues(df = NULL, se = NULL)
  vals2 <- reactiveValues(df = NULL, se = NULL)

  observeEvent({
    input$slope
    input$intercept
    input$realslope
    input$realintercept
  }, {
    x <- runif(50, min = 18, max = 40)
    y <- input$realintercept + input$realslope * x + rnorm(50, sd = 2)

    vals$df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y) %>%
      mutate(
        s = input$slope,
        i = input$intercept,
        estimated = i + s * x,
        error = y - estimated
      )

    vals$se <- sum(vals$df$error^2) / nrow(vals$df)
  })

  observeEvent({
    input$slope2
    input$realslope2
    input$realintercept2
  }, {
    x <- runif(50, min = 18, max = 40)
    y <- input$realintercept2 + input$realslope2 * x + rnorm(50, sd = 2)

    vals2$df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y) %>%
      mutate(
        s = input$slope2,
        i = mean(y) - mean(x) * input$slope2,
        estimated = i + s * x,
        error = y - estimated
      )

    vals2$se <- sum(vals2$df$error^2) / nrow(vals2$df)
  })

  output$regplot <- renderPlot({
    df <- vals$df
    lim <- get_square_limits(df)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_point(aes(y = estimated), color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_abline(aes(intercept = i, slope = s), color = "skyblue") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = y, ymax = estimated),
                    color = "skyblue", linetype = 2) +
      coord_fixed(xlim = lim$xlim, ylim = lim$ylim, expand = FALSE) +
      theme_bw()
  })

  output$seplot <- renderPlot({
    df <- vals$df
    lim <- get_square_limits(df, include_rectangles = TRUE)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_point(aes(y = estimated), color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_abline(aes(intercept = i, slope = s), color = "skyblue") +
      geom_rect(aes(ymin = pmin(y, estimated),
                    ymax = pmax(y, estimated),
                    xmin = pmin(x, x - error),
                    xmax = pmax(x, x - error)),
                fill = "firebrick1", alpha = 0.1, color = "firebrick1") +
      coord_fixed(xlim = lim$xlim, ylim = lim$ylim, expand = FALSE) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0("Mean Squared Error: ", round(vals$se, 2)))
  })

  output$regplot2 <- renderPlot({
    df <- vals2$df
    lim <- get_square_limits(df)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_point(aes(y = estimated), color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_abline(aes(intercept = i, slope = s), color = "skyblue") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = y, ymax = estimated),
                    color = "skyblue", linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(shape = 18, color = "red",
                 aes(x = mean(x), y = mean(y)), size = 4) +
      coord_fixed(xlim = lim$xlim, ylim = lim$ylim, expand = FALSE) +
      theme_bw()
  })

  output$seplot2 <- renderPlot({
    df <- vals2$df
    lim <- get_square_limits(df, include_rectangles = TRUE)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_point(aes(y = estimated), color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_abline(aes(intercept = i, slope = s), color = "skyblue") +
      geom_rect(aes(ymin = pmin(y, estimated),
                    ymax = pmax(y, estimated),
                    xmin = pmin(x, x - error),
                    xmax = pmax(x, x - error)),
                fill = "firebrick1", alpha = 0.1, color = "firebrick1") +
      geom_point(shape = 18, color = "red",
                 aes(x = mean(x), y = mean(y)), size = 4) +
      coord_fixed(xlim = lim$xlim, ylim = lim$ylim, expand = FALSE) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0("Mean Squared Error: ", round(vals2$se, 2)))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


```
